UpSet plot of overlapping protein sets

Source: R/plot_omics_extra.R
plot_upset.Rd

Native `ggplot2` + `patchwork` UpSet plot showing exclusive intersection sizes across two or more protein/biomarker sets (e.g. significant hits across cohorts, timepoints, or contrasts), with optional per-set size bars on the left.

Usage

plot_upset(
  sets,
  n_intersections = 15,
  order = c("size", "degree"),
  min_size = 1,
  set_bars = TRUE,
  colour = "#0072B2",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL
)

Arguments

sets

Named list of two or more character vectors (protein/assay IDs).

n_intersections

Maximum number of intersections to display (default `15`).

order

`"size"` (default; largest intersection first) or `"degree"` (fewest sets first, then size).

min_size

Minimum intersection size to include (default `1`).

set_bars

Logical; show total set-size bars on the left (default `TRUE`).

colour

Fill colour for the intersection size bars (default `"#0072B2"`).

title, subtitle

Optional plot title and subtitle.

Value

A `patchwork` object (or `ggplot` bar chart with a warning if `patchwork` is not installed).

Examples

sets <- list(
  CohortA = c("IL6", "TNF", "CXCL10", "CD40", "CCL2"),
  CohortB = c("IL6", "TNF", "IFNG", "IL10"),
  CohortC = c("IL6", "CD40", "IL10", "VEGFA")
)
plot_upset(sets, title = "Shared Significant Proteins")
